title: Rethinking Meeting Effectiveness: A Benchmark and Framework for Temporal Fine-grained Automatic Meeting Effectiveness Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2604.17260v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating meeting effectiveness is crucial for improving organizational productivity. Current approaches rely on post-hoc surveys that yield a single coarse-grained score for an entire meeting. The reliance on manual assessment is inherently limited in scalability, cost, and reproducibility. Moreover, a single score fails to capture the dynamic nature of collaborative discussions. We propose a new paradigm for evaluating meeting effectiveness centered on novel criteria and temporal fine-grained approach. We define effectiveness as the rate of objective achievement over time and assess it for individual topical segments within a meeting. To support this task, we introduce the AMI Meeting Effectiveness (AMI-ME) dataset, a new meta-evaluation dataset containing 2,459 human-annotated segments from 130 AMI Corpus meetings. translated_title: 重新思考会议有效性：一个用于时间细粒度自动会议有效性评估的基准与框架
translated_abstract: 评估会议有效性对于提升组织生产力至关重要。当前的方法依赖于事后调查，只能为整场会议产生一个单一的粗粒度评分。对人工评估的依赖在可扩展性、成本和可重复性方面存在固有的局限。此外，单一评分无法捕捉协作讨论的动态特性。我们提出了一种以全新标准和时间细粒度方法为核心的会议有效性评估新范式。我们将有效性定义为随时间推移目标达成的速率，并对会议中各个主题片段分别进行评估。为支持这一任务，我们引入了AMI会议有效性（AMI-ME）数据集，这是一个新的元评估数据集，包含来自130场AMI语料库会议的2,459个人工标注片段。我们还开发了一个自动有效性评估框架，该框架使用大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者来……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种时间细粒度的会议有效性评估新范式，将有效性定义为目标随时间达成的速率，并构建了包含130场会议、2,459个人工标注片段的AMI-ME数据集，同时开发了基于LLM作为评判者的自动评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new paradigm for temporal fine-grained meeting effectiveness evaluation by defining effectiveness as the rate of objective achievement over time, introducing the AMI-ME benchmark with 2,459 human-annotated segments from 130 meetings, and developing an automatic evaluation framework that uses an LLM as a judge.
